book_level_anchors.decision: Preserve repeated 'great' language where it structures city, wind/storm, fish, and emotional scale.
Use get up / got up to preserve repeated commission-response language.
Use contextually natural English for ra'ah (evil/trouble/disaster/displeasure/discomfort) while exposing the Hebrew network in apparatus.
Preserve fear language, especially the sailors' movement from fear of the storm to fear of the LORD.
Preserve appoint for fish, plant, worm, and wind.
Preserve turn / relent language in Jonah 3 and 4.
Use steadfast love for God's hesed in 4:2; keep Jonah 2:8's hesed construction explicitly disputed.

f3_decisions.decision: Retain covenant loyalty in main text; ambiguity note required
Retain exceedingly great city; note Hebrew 'great to God'
Use natural English while noting ra'ah wordplay
Retain right/left idiom; leave interpretation open
